basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Visiting Artist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) has released the recruitment notification for 1 Visiting Artist vacancy on a contract basis for a duration of 3 months. The post carries a pay of Rs. 30,000 and applicants must have passed Class 12th from Central or State Board of Education, with an age limit of 21 to 65 years. Eligible candidates can apply online by submitting their applications through the google form to reach the PI on or before 31 October 2026. The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by an interview.

how_to_apply: Visit the CCLT webpage or use the official online application link provided in the notification.
Access the Google Form via Application Form.
Fill out all required details in the Google Form completely.
Submit the completed application form to reach the Principal Investigator (PI) on or before 31 October 2026.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the provided Google Form. Incomplete applications or those submitted after the due date will result in disqualification or rejection. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview. The selected candidate must join immediately upon receipt of the offer. The appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the institute and funding agency.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Visiting Artist at a Glance
Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Visiting Artist position must fulfill the essential qualification. Those with desirable qualifications may be given preference during the selection process. Essential Qualification: Must have passed Class 12th from Central or State Board of Education. Desirable Qualification: Recipient of state or national awards/honours. Eligible Fields: Artists working in performing arts and handicrafts of Chhattisgarh. Age Limit: 21 to 65 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Visiting Artist will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 30,000 per month. The position is funded by the National Thermal Power Company Ltd (NTPC) under the Centre for Studies on Culture Language and Traditions (CCLT) at IIT Bhilai. The duration of the appointment is 3 months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Bhilai Visiting Artist
content_sections.text: Visit the CCLT webpage or use the official online application link provided in the notification. Access the Google Form via Application Form . Fill out all required details in the Google Form completely. Submit the completed application form to reach the Principal Investigator (PI) on or before 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. If the number of shortlisted candidates called for the interview is large, the selection committee may decide to restrict the number of candidates for the interview to a reasonable limit after considering qualifications and experience over and above the minimum prescribed requirements. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The decision of the selection committee will be final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the provided Google Form. Incomplete applications or those submitted after the due date will result in disqualification or rejection. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview. The selected candidate must join immediately upon receipt of the offer. The appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the institute and funding agency.
